about: Local simulator results (SkyShards engine BH5LZfv8, wiki-max stats, 3 plots). Normal: one plot running the layout full time with its inputs in stock (3 seeds x 2000 cycles). Profit share: the user's chain formula, s = 1 + sum of input plot-days per main plot-day, main uptime 1/s, by-products credited (a filled layout's commons). Ironman: the bootstrap flow, its round length tuned per mutation (data/rounds.json), run from an empty inventory (Dead Plants, Fire and Fermento free) for 9000 cycles. NPC coins only (mutation items count 0). Common mutations drop no Fermento or Helianthus (the user's alpha harvests, 27 Oct); base crops still do. Lonelily is only used as an input.
